svg.text: Ferrite pure-Rust worldgen scaling — detailed run (2026-11-23)
Full RustGenerator::generate (terrain, structure starts/jigsaw, decoration); lighting, serialization and networking excluded.
Xeon Platinum 8358 · 12 logical CPUs (6 cores × 2 SMT) · seed 12345 · 256 Overworld chunks × 5 trials per thread count · one process at a time
line = median of 5 trials; band = trial min–max; dashed = linear scaling
dashed = perfect scaling; label = parallel efficiency
worker-side Instant per chunk over 256 chunks; median across trials
speedup ÷ threads; 12 logical CPUs are 6 physical cores × 2 SMT
median of 3 trials × 128 chunks at 1 / 4 / 12 threads; column heights differ by dimension
6T: 5.80x at 721 chunks/s (p50 7.87 ms); 12T: 6.22x at 773 chunks/s (p50 14.68 ms). SMT adds 7% throughput for 87% higher p50.
